question: After a Cisco Nexus 7000 Series switch chassis replacement, the administrator discovers that all vPC-enabled LACP port channels are reinitialized. The administrator wants to prevent this issue the next time the chassis is replaced. Which two actions must be taken to meet this requirement before the isolated device is reloaded? (Choose two.)
options: Change the vPC system-priority of the replacement chassis to a higher value than the peer
Set the vPC MAC address to a higher value than the peer
Configure auto-recovery to the disable state on both peers
Set the vPC MAC address to a lower value than the peer
Change the vPC system-priority of the replacement chassis to a lower value than the peer
